display.purpose: The couple's first names, set as gold leaf — the emotional peak. Cinzel Decorative, uppercase.

script.purpose: The ampersand and intimate connective phrases. Great Vibes, Gold Deep.

headline.purpose: Section labels, surname line, button text. Cinzel, 5px tracking, uppercase, Gold Deep.

arabic.purpose: All Arabic strings, RTL, Amiri, line-height 1.9. Equal billing with Latin.

body.purpose: Running invitation prose on cream, often italic. Cormorant Garamond, measure capped ~720px column.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Warm candlelight pooling under a detail card at rest. Never a gray drop shadow.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Card lifts toward the light on hover (paired with translateY(-6px)).

shadows.name: floater
shadows.purpose: Detaches fixed floaters (lang pill, dock) from the scroll.

motion.name: reveal-ease
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for scroll reveals. Slow (1s), no bounce.

motion.name: button-ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for button/link state transitions — slow and intentional.

motion.name: ornament-draw
motion.purpose: Gold ornament dividers draw their own strokes on reveal.

components.name: Gold Outline Button
components.description: Calendar / directions actions. Gold fill sweeps in from the left on hover; text turns white.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 26px; border: 1px solid #c9a44c; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #8c6d2a; text-decoration: none; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: color 0.4s ease; } .ds-btn-gold > * { position: relative; z-index: 2; } .ds-btn-gold::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; background: #c9a44c; transform: translateX(-101%); transition: transform 0.45s ease; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-btn-gold:hover::before { transform: translateX(0); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f1d894; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Gradient Button
components.description: The RSVP commit action — the one place gold fills a control. The single allowed gleam in its viewport.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; color: #fff; font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(120deg, #8c6d2a, #c9a44c, #f1d894); transition: filter 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f1d894; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Detail Card
components.description: One of the three at-a-glance facts (date/venue/time). A translucent pane of light over the warm stage, lifting on hover.
components.html: Sunday, September 13, 2026
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(201,164,76,0.35); border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.55), rgba(250,246,236,0.25)); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -18px rgba(140,109,42,0.6); text-align: center; transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(140,109,42,0.65); } .ds-card-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; margin: 0 auto 12px; fill: none; stroke: #c9a44c; stroke-width: 1.4; } .ds-card-text { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; color: #3a3020; line-height: 1.35; }

components.name: RSVP Input
components.description: Translucent white field with a gold hairline border. Serif text, gold-deep placeholder.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(201,164,76,0.4); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; color: #2c2114; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(140,109,42,0.5); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f1d894; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #c9a44c; }

components.name: Attendance Toggle
components.description: Segmented pill radio. Unselected is gold-outline; selected fills solid gold with white text.
components.html: I WILL ATTENDCAN'T MAKE IT
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; } .ds-toggle-seg { height: 48px; line-height: 48px; border: 1px solid rgba(201,164,76,0.4); border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #8c6d2a; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; } .ds-toggle-seg--on { background: #c9a44c; color: #fff; border-color: #c9a44c; }

components.name: Language Switcher
components.description: Fixed top-right pill toggle, gold-bordered, frosted cream. Active segment fills solid gold.
components.css: .ds-lang { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(201,164,76,0.5); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(250,246,236,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-lang-seg { padding: 6px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #8c6d2a; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; } .ds-lang-seg--on { background: #c9a44c; color: #fff; } .ds-lang-seg:not(.ds-lang-seg--on):hover { background: rgba(201,164,76,0.1); }

components.name: Ornament Divider
components.description: Signature gold linework divider. Strokes draw themselves on reveal; a diamond fades in after.
components.html: <svg class="ds-orn" viewBox="0 0 200 16" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="0" y1="8" x2="85" y2="8"/><path class="ds-orn-diamond" d="M100 3 L105 8 L100 13 L95 8 Z"/><line x1="115" y1="8" x2="200" y2="8"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-orn { display: block; width: 200px; max-width: 70%; margin: 32px auto; } .ds-orn line { stroke: #c9a44c; stroke-width: 1.1; fill: none; } .ds-orn-diamond { fill: #c9a44c; stroke: none; }

narrative.overview: A hand-pressed invitation sealed in gold — a single, continuous, cinematic scroll that opens like an object rather than loads like a page. The world is night and candlelight: a deep near-black entrance gives way to a warm cream stage, lit from the edges by faint gold glows and framed by two hairline gold rails. The personality is couture, ceremonial, intimate — the voice of a fashion house's invitation (Dior/Chanel), not a vendor's product page. Confidence is carried by space and timing, not ornament density. Gold is treated as a precious metal: a name, a hairline, a single seal — never a coat. The system is trilingual at its core: French, Arabic (true RTL, Amiri), and English each get type and rhythm worthy of the language.
keyCharacteristics: Night-to-cream cinematic arc; candlelight, not fluorescence.
Gold as jewelry — a single gleam, never a surface.
Generous vertical rhythm; space is the status symbol.
Centered, framed editorial column (max ~720px) on a warm stage.
Trilingual first-class typography (Latin serif + Amiri Arabic).
Slow, choreographed reveal motion with full reduced-motion fallbacks.

rules.name: The "Gold Is Jewelry, Not Paint" Rule
rules.body: Gold appears as a highlight, a hairline, a name, or a seal — never as a fill across a surface. One gleam reads as precious; a coat reads as cheap. If a viewport has more than one element wearing the full gold gradient, you are painting, not setting a jewel — pull back.

rules.name: The Readable-Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold text is always Gold Deep (#8c6d2a), never bright gold. Bright gold is for light (glows, focus rings, gradient catch-lights), never for words on cream — it fails contrast.

rules.name: The No-Sans Rule
rules.body: This invitation has no sans-serif. Every face is a serif or a script. A sans anywhere reads as 'app,' and this is not an app.

rules.name: The Equal-Billing Rule
rules.body: Arabic is never an afterthought. It gets a true Arabic typeface (Amiri), correct RTL direction and mirroring, and its own line-height — not a Latin layout with the strings swapped.

rules.name: The Candlelight-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are warm (gold-brown rgba(140,109,42,…)), tightly negative-spread, and soft. A neutral-gray or hard-edged shadow is forbidden — it would read as a generic web card and break the candlelit world.

dos: Do keep gold as a single gleam per viewport — a name, a hairline, a seal, one filled commit button. ('Gold Is Jewelry, Not Paint.')
Do set all gold text in Gold Deep (#8c6d2a); reserve bright gold for light (glows, focus rings, gradient catch-lights).
Do give every language a real typeface — Latin serifs for FR/EN, Amiri + RTL for Arabic. Never swap strings into a Latin layout.
Do keep shadows warm and candlelit (rgba(140,109,42,…)), soft, and tightly negative-spread.
Do lean on space and slow, choreographed reveals to carry luxury; protect generous vertical rhythm and the ~720px centered column.
Do keep cards at rounded-2xl (16px) and reserve them for the three at-a-glance facts only.
Do ship a calm static fallback for every animation under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't make it look like a free e-invite maker — no clip-art florals, sticker confetti, cartoon hearts, or drag-and-drop stock layouts. This is the single biggest tell to avoid.

Don't import corporate / SaaS-landing patterns — no hero-metric blocks, no identical icon-heading-text card grids, no gradient feature heroes, no navy-and-gold fintech palette. This is a celebration, not a product page.
Don't drift into gold kitsch — no glitter overload, heavy bevels, hard drop shadows, or gold-on-gold-on-gold. Gold is precious because it's rare.
Don't go cold-minimalist — restraint is not absence of feeling; keep the Maghrebi warmth and ceremony alive.
Don't introduce a sans-serif anywhere ('The No-Sans Rule'). A sans reads as 'app.'
Don't over-round (no 24px+ card radii) or use neutral-gray / hard-edged shadows — both read as a generic web template.
Don't set gold text on bright gold or muted gold-on-cream below 4.5:1; readability is part of the luxury, and the guest list skews older.
